patch.summary: AWeber implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement AWeber by mapping current email-marketing workflows to AWeber objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (WordPress, Shopify, Stripe) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on WordPress

blocks.heading: AWeber day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat AWeber setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Creators and solopreneurs needing email + landing pages + basic funnels before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate WordPress and Shopify before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps
Do not expand seats until email campaigns is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Lite caps lists, LPs, automations, users, and segments vs Plus

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Marketing pricing page emphasizes Lite/Plus/Done For You; Unlimited details live primarily in docs

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Promo setup fees and 'months free' offers are time-limited — verify live checkout

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: AWeber plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Lite
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Plus
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Unlimited
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Large account (100k+)
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate email-marketing fit before a deep AWeber rollout
blocks.body: If AWeber fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft AWeber object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on email campaigns
If blocked, evaluate GetResponse before sunk-cost expansion
